name: Aim Charm
notes: Aim Charm: more accuracy points for the player's moves at each of its 4 levels: +3, +2, +3, +2 (+10 in all: a 90% move never misses; 2.5 a level, taking turns since there are no half points). Adds that to boost_aim. Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_aim' (back to 0 each run).
title: AIM CHARM
